payload.title: Application code still iterates tenant schemas by name under FORCE RLS in seven files: cron-jobs.service (8 jobs, including the destructive minio.orphan-cleanup), hr-service leave accrual and certification expiry, messaging retention, partition manager and knowledge extraction, sensor continuous aggregates
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/scheduler/cron-jobs.service.ts:324 (listTenantSchemas then a bare QueryRunner with SET search_path)
payload.rule_violated: A worker that touches tenant tables binds its tenant (forEachVerifiedTenantSchema, findTenantsMatching, runInTenantTransaction), never a schema name alone
payload.notes: Found while fixing FARM-HIGH-481. The same defect as the task crons: a runner with only a search_path reads nothing under FORCE RLS, so these jobs find nothing to do. hr, messaging and sensor are UNVERIFIED on production (the pattern is the same, whether each table is under RLS and which role runs it was not checked). minio.orphan-cleanup deletes objects: converting it activates a destructive job and needs its own review.
narrative: The spec holds each file at its current call count; it fails when one grows and when one shrinks without the count being lowered.
